description: This bar chart illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT for three language models: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, across three categories—Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks every 10 units. For each category, there are three bars representing each language model; Llama3 is blue, Qwen2 is red, and ChatGPT is yellow. For “Movies,” the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 87%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 89%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 73%. For “Songs,” the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 87%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 64%. For “Basketball,” the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 68%, the Qwen2 bar reaches approximately 57%, and the ChatGPT bar reaches approximately 62%. The bars are arranged in groups by category, with each group containing a bar for each language model. No bars are visually emphasized or sorted in any apparent order.
